description: Implementation of WebSocket HTTP/2 handshake stream handling, including request initiation, response processing, and upgrade to WebSocket stream.

classes.name: WebSocketHttp2HandshakeStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket handshake over HTTP/2, manages request/response lifecycle, and upgrades to WebSocket stream.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Stores the HTTP request info and traffic annotation.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with priority and logging.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends the WebSocket handshake request over HTTP/2.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers, triggers validation.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Not implemented; callers should upgrade to WebSocketStream.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Indicates if response body is complete (always false).

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if connection is reused (always true).

methods.name: SetConnectionReused
methods.description: Marks connection as reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Indicates if connection can be reused (always false).

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Indicates if alternative service info is available (always false).

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing info.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL info.

methods.name: GetSSLCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Not supported; client cert request info not available for multiplexed streams.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets remote network endpoint.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details (no-op).

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Closes the stream, marking it as not reusable.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets request priority.

methods.name: RenewStreamForAuth
methods.description: Renewing stream for authentication is not supported.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to this stream.

methods.name: OnHeadersSent
methods.description: Callback when headers are sent; runs stored callback.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Processes received response headers and validates response.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure and errors.

methods.name: StartRequestCallback
methods.description: Callback after starting request; handles success or failure.

methods.name: ValidateResponse
methods.description: Validates the response code and headers.

methods.name: ValidateUpgradeResponse
methods.description: Validates WebSocket upgrade response headers.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios, reports error.
